learning_objective: The learner will classify each of ten changes under Added, Changed, Fixed, or Removed, with at least 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** release-note-sorter
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Understand
**Bloom Verb:** classify
**Learning Objective:** The learner will classify each of ten changes under Added, Changed, Fixed, or Removed, with at least 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Release Notes (defined in this chapter above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each change the learner commits one of four headings. A placement is correct when it matches the Correct heading column in Content. Mastery is at least 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt. Reading the four headings is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) Every edit is a fix. (2) A change that improves a feature is an addition. (3) Removing outdated content is not worth mentioning. **Instructional Rationale:** Classifying changes under headings is an Understand-level action that turns a log into readable notes. Ten changes spread over four headings teach the learner the dividing lines. **Content:** The four headings and their meanings: Added (something new), Changed (something that existed now works or reads differently), Fixed (an error or a defect was corrected), Removed (something was taken out). The ten changes (all made up, for Watershed Basics v1.1): | # | Change | Correct heading | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Added captions to the lesson video. | Added | Captions are new. | | 2 | Added a simulation of rain and ground cover. | Added | The simulation is new. | | 3 | Updated the river length from 410 to 398 miles. | Changed | An existing fact now reads differently. | | 4 | Replaced two broken links. | Fixed | The links were defects. | | 5 | Split the quiz into its own component. | Changed | An existing part is organized differently. | | 6 | Corrected the heading that skipped from level 2 to level 4. | Fixed | The heading order was a defect. | | 7 | Removed the outdated 2019 rainfall chart. | Removed | Something was taken out. | | 8 | Added a glossary entry for "aquifer". | Added | The entry is new. | | 9 | Corrected the quiz script path so the quiz loads on tablets. | Fixed | The path was a defect. | | 10 | Rewrote the introduction at a lower reading level. | Changed | An existing paragraph now reads differently. | **Provenance:** The changes are illustrative examples written for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". The headings follow the chapter section "Release Notes". **Rules:** Each change has exactly one correct heading. Added, Changed, and Fixed hold three changes each, and Removed holds one. **Learner Activity:** 1. The learner sees one change and the four headings. 2. The learner places the change under a heading, and the placement is committed. 3. The sim shows whether it was correct and the Why text. 4. After change 10 the sim shows the summary and the finished release notes. **Feedback:** 10 changes in a shuffled order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [heading]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. This change is [heading]. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 10 correct on the first attempt". At 9 or more it adds "You can write release notes." Below 9 it lists the Why text of each missed change. **Starting State:** The first change in the shuffled order and the four headings. The question shown is "Under which heading does this change belong?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter names the four headings Added, Changed, Fixed, and Removed, and its example release is Watershed Basics v1.1.
